02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with T.R No.55 of 2023 pending on the file of learned ADJ- cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Puri arising out of Sadar P.S. Case No.150 of 2023 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 450/ 376(3)/ 294/ 506 of IPC and Sec.6 of the POCSO Act and Sec.3(1)(r)(s)/3(2)(v)(va) of SC/ST(PA) Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned Addl. District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act,
Puri by order dated 06.05.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the in the meanwhile victim has already been examined after the order of rejection.
6. Taking note of the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application at this stage.
7. Liberty is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin, who Naresh Jena @ Nari vs State Of Odisha ....
